name: Gwidion

attributes.attribute: A Welsh hero and magician in the Mabinogion.
Son of the mother goddess Dôn.

sources: Monaghan, Patricia. The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore. Checkmark Books, 2008.
text: Gwidion is an alternate spelling of Gwydion. Gwydion was a Welsh hero and magician who was the son of the great mother goddess Dôn in the Mabinogion. The name appears as a cross-reference pointing readers to the fuller entry on Gwydion.

okr.objective: Clarify Gwidion as an alternate spelling of the hero Gwydion.
